I have a complete picture of the current duplicate-detection implementation. Here is my report.

## Summary

Duplicate detection is currently implemented as **three separate, sequential OfficeFloor steps** (telephone, email, household) in the `POST /api/owners` pipeline, each with its own exception + handler returning 409. The acceptance tests (already rewritten) now expect these to be **consolidated into a single derived `identityKey` = `normalizedTelephone||normalizedEmail||householdId`**, exposed as a read-only field on the Owner response. That field and any consolidated check **do not exist yet** — the tests will currently fail.

## 1. The create pipeline (POST /owners)

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — guarded by `authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"`. Step order (all `govern: [ transaction ]`):
`validate → ensureUniqueTelephone → ensureUniqueEmail → ensureUniqueHousehold → ensureCityCapacity → ensureDailyLimit → build → assignHousehold → assignHouseholdSize → assignCustomerCode → assignNamesakeCount → assignBulkSignupWarning → save → audit → respond`

The three consecutive `ensureUnique*` steps are the duplicate-detection logic to consolidate.

## 2. Duplicate-detection functions (all in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`)

**`EnsureUniqueTelephone.java`** — normalizes request telephone to E.164 and compares against `TelephoneE164.normalize(existing.getTelephone())` for every `ownerRepository.findAll()`; throws `DuplicateTelephoneException`.

**`EnsureUniqueEmail.java`** — email optional (null/blank skips). Normalizes by `trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)` on both sides; throws `DuplicateEmailException`. (Has its own private `normalize`.)

**`EnsureUniqueHousehold.java`** — opt-out when `request.getSharesHousehold()` is true. Compares `normalize(lastName)` (trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase) AND `AddressNormalizer.normalize(address)`; throws `DuplicateHouseholdException`. (Has its own private `normalize`.)

All three loop over `ownerRepository.findAll()` with **no soft-delete filter** (note: `DeleteOwner.java` does a hard `ownerRepository.delete(owner)`, despite `AcceptanceBase.deleteOwner`'s comment claiming soft-delete that duplicate checks ignore — a discrepancy relevant to consolidation).

## 3. Telephone normalization

**`TelephoneE164.java`** (package-private `final class`, static `normalize(String)`): strips spaces/dashes/brackets; keeps a leading `+` country code, else assumes `+61` dropping one leading `0`; enforces 8–15 digits, with exact national-length rules (`+61`→9, `+1`→10); returns `null` when invalid. This is the canonical telephone-normalization logic — the "normalizedTelephone" component of the future identityKey.

## 4. Address / household-id logic

**`AddressNormalizer.java`** (package-private, static `normalize`): trim, collapse whitespace, uppercase, expand `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`; idempotent; empty string when blank.

**`AssignHousehold.java`** — on `sharesHousehold=true`, computes `householdId = shaHex(normalize(lastName)+"\n"+AddressNormalizer.normalize(address))` → first **12 hex chars, UPPERCASE** of SHA-256. Sets it on the new owner and backfills every already-stored matching member. Contains its own private `normalize`, `householdId`, and `sha256hex`. This is the source of the `householdId` component of the future identityKey.

**`AssignHouseholdSize.java`** / **`AssignNamesakeCount.java`** — counting rules (household member count, namesake count) that also iterate `findAll()`; related context but not duplicate-rejection.

Supporting: **`ValidateOwnerFields.java`** (runs first; normalizes telephone via `TelephoneE164`, email to lowercase, address via `AddressNormalizer`, republishes body as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`), **`BuildOwner.java`**, **`SaveOwner.java`**.

## 5. `householdId` on the Owner model

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** — `@Column(name = "household_id") private String householdId;` (lines 60-61) with getter/setter (126-132). Also present: `telephone` (E.164 `@Pattern`, lines 46-49), `email` (51-52), `customerCode`, `namesakeCount`, `householdSize`, and a `@Transient bulkSignupWarning`. **There is no `identityKey` field/column yet.**

## 6. DTOs / OpenAPI (generated at build)

DTOs (`OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerDto`) are **MapStruct/OpenAPI-generated** — no committed `.java` files. Schema in **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**:
- `OwnerFields` (line 1991): `firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone` (required), `email, registrationDate`, and write-only `sharesHousehold` (line 2047).
- `Owner` allOf (line 2059) adds read-only: `id, displayName, initials, customerCode`, **`householdId`** (line 2092), `namesakeCount, membershipNumber, membershipLevel`, etc. **No `identityKey` property** — must be added here for it to appear on responses.

`OwnerMapper.java` maps derived fields via `@Mapping expression`; a consolidated identityKey could be added similarly.

## 7. Exceptions & handlers (409 CONFLICT)

All in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/`:
- **`DuplicateTelephoneException.java`**, **`DuplicateEmailException.java`**, **`DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** — all `extends Exception` (checked).
- **`DuplicateTelephoneExceptionHandler.java`**, **`DuplicateEmailExceptionHandler.java`**, **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler.java`** — each builds a `ProblemDetail` via `ProblemDetails.build(ex, HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ...)` and responds `ResponseEntity.status(CONFLICT)`.

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners who share a household (same lastName and address), created via sharesHousehold. All owners in one household carry the same value; null for owners not part of a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Null when either customerCode or registrationDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "A numeric level from 1 to 3 assigned at creation: start at 1, add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on the current business day at the moment this owner was created, signalling a possible bulk-signup event; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the city via a fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (they share a household). Request-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners who share a household (same lastName and address), created via sharesHousehold. All owners in one household carry the same value; null for owners not part of a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Null when either customerCode or registrationDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "A numeric level from 1 to 3 assigned at creation: start at 1, add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on the current business day at the moment this owner was created, signalling a possible bulk-signup event; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the city via a fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string

## Summary

I consolidated all owner duplicate detection into a single derived `identityKey` and made it the only rejection rule.

**The key** (`OwnerIdentity.of(owner)`, new helper):
```
identityKey = normalizedTelephone + "|" + (email or "") + "|" + (householdId or "")
```
Built from fields already canonicalised earlier in the pipeline (telephone in E.164, email lower-cased, `householdId` once assigned).

**Behaviour change:** the three separate `EnsureUnique{Telephone,Email,Household}` steps (each its own `Duplicate*Exception`/handler/escalation, all returning 409) are gone. A single `EnsureUniqueIdentity` step now rejects with 409 only when a new owner's **whole** `identityKey` equals an existing owner's. Because telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household (same `householdId`) with different telephones now have distinct keys and are both allowed — only an exact full-key match collides.

**Ordering:** the check runs *after* `assignHousehold` so the `householdId` component is populated before the key is formed (the new owner isn't saved yet, so it's never compared against itself).

**`identityKey` is returned** — added as a read-only property on the OpenAPI `Owner` schema and mapped in `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto`, so it appears on both create (201) and GET responses.

Changes:
- **New:** `OwnerIdentity`, `EnsureUniqueIdentity`, `DuplicateIdentityException` + handler + escalation YAML.
- **Modified:** `owners.POST.yml` (3 steps → 1, repositioned), `openapi.yml` (new field), `OwnerMapper.java` (new mapping), `AssignHousehold.java` (stale javadoc refs).
- **Deleted:** 3 `EnsureUnique*` classes, 3 `Duplicate*Exception` + 3 handlers, 3 escalation YAMLs.

Tests: the five duplicate-detection checkpoints (Cp03, Cp10, Cp11, Cp25, Cp28) and the full 39-test suite all pass.
